Attack Vector: Malicious apps disguised as legitimate apps on Google Play store
Installation of apps requesting notification access permissions
Method of Attack: Generates unauthorized charges by subscribing users to premium services in the background
Requests access to notification content to capture subscription confirmation codes
Decodes hidden payload containing malicious code executed to contact C2 server
Opens website in invisible web browser window to subscribe victim to premium service
Retrieves confirmation codes from device notifications and submits them to finalize subscription
Hides malicious activity behind promised app functionality to avoid suspicion
Uses obfuscation and native libraries to increase evasiveness and complicate analysis
